description: Defines the GATTProfile class and related nested classes for managing Bluetooth GATT profiles, services, and characteristics, including discovery and attribute reading functionalities.

classes.name: GATTProfile
classes.description: Manages Bluetooth GATT profile discovery, services, and characteristics, including attribute reading and event handling.

classes.name: GATTProfile::Service
classes.description: Represents a Bluetooth GATT service with its characteristics.

classes.name: GATTProfile::Characteristic
classes.description: Represents a Bluetooth GATT characteristic with descriptors and data.

classes.name: GATTProfile::Characteristic::Descriptor
classes.description: Represents a descriptor within a GATT characteristic.

methods.name: Discover
methods.description: Discovers services on a Bluetooth device within a specified wait time.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Checks if the profile discovery is valid and complete.

methods.name: Services
methods.description: Returns an iterator over discovered services.

methods.name: Find
methods.description: Finds characteristics within a service matching given UUIDs.

methods.name: FindHandle
methods.description: Finds handle for a characteristic or descriptor.

methods.name: LoadCharacteristics
methods.description: Loads characteristics and descriptors for a service.

methods.name: AvailableTime
methods.description: Calculates remaining time for discovery operations.

methods.name: NextCharacteristic
methods.description: Advances to next characteristic during attribute reading.
